200.description: One keyset page of the order's authorizations, newest first.

disposition.description: Decided by this context at authorization; the caller never chooses it.

quantity.description: The quantity placed on that order line (eaches).

unitPriceCents.description: Optional; the caller-declared price, echoed back. Never published on any event.

ownerRef.description: Optional; whose stock the line took (the sourcing release's ownerRef), when known.

destinationNodeId.description: Optional; omitted for KEEP (no destination) and when no node is known.

originNodeId.description: Optional; the node that fulfilled the group, when a sourcing fact named it.

trackingNumbers.description: The linked reverse-label tracking numbers, in issue order; at most five.

closedAt.description: Optional; set by every terminal state.

version.description: The aggregate version after the last change.

pricesAbsent.description: True when at least one line had no unit price, so KEEP could never be chosen.

nextCursor.description: Present when another page follows; feed it back as the cursor query parameter.

400.description: The Idempotency-Key is missing (`idempotency-key-required`), malformed (`idempotency-key-invalid`) or reused on a different request (`idempotency-key-reused`, 409); a malformed query is `validation-failed`.

type.description: The kebab-case slug of the error category.

422.description: The body or the world refuses the command; `validation-failed` (malformed body, unknown line, over the line ceiling), `group-not-shipped`, `no-return-destination`, `label-unavailable` or `authorization-expired`.

type.description: The kebab-case slug of the error category.

example.title: The order group is not shipped or delivered yet; retry later with the same Idempotency-Key

500.description: An unexpected failure; the body never leaks the internal error.

type.description: The kebab-case slug of the error category.
